title: Golden Plains
palette: honey grass, soft cream limestone, sage green, lavender distance, brilliant pale blue sky
scene: An immense golden meadow at first-person eye level. A broad pale dirt trail begins at bottom center and rolls gently over low hills between sunlit tall grasses, passing a few weathered pale standing stones toward distant lilac mountains. Wildflower specks, luminous blue sky with billowing pearl clouds, calm warm afternoon breeze suggested by grass arcs. A beautiful original open landscape with clear navigation, no farms or buildings.
wall: flat pale warm limestone with quiet irregular fractures
floor: flat pale warm compacted earth path with fine cream grit
secondary: flat interwoven dry golden meadow grass groundcover with muted sage blades, no horizon
detail: flat weathered warm honey-gray timber grain with small muted moss flecks
